_note: Viper generation reference. The agent maps a year (or a model/chassis slug found in a post) to a generation number 1-5 for the findings index. Operator-editable. Year ranges are inclusive. When a post names only a chassis slug (RT/10, GTS, ZB1, etc.) use the slugs[] hints; when it names a year, use the year range.
_ambiguous_note: Some slugs (RT/10, ACR) span more than one generation; prefer an explicit year when present. ACR existed in Gen 2 (1999-2002), Gen 4 (2008-2010), and Gen 5 (2016-2017). If generation is genuinely indeterminate, record generation:null and rely on year + part_description.
